newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian stocks' hit more records, banks lead.
newsitem.headline: Estonian stocks' hit more records, banks lead.

text.p: Most Estonian banking stocks set new highs on Thursday, with Hansapank and Savings Bank especially strong, as the bullish market hit new records, dealers said.
"The February results from most of the banks were good so small investors have been very active there," one trader said.
The stock exchange index gained 3.03 percent to close at 217.06 on turnover of 65 million kroons on the official list.
Hansapank was 8.75 kroons higher to end trading on 215.75 kroons after 15.4 million of kroons of shares were traded.
Savings Bank turned over 7.0 million kroons of shares to close 5.05 kroons higher on 107.95 kroons.
Tallinna Pank was also active with a turnover of 11.0 million kroons to finish 0.25 kroons higher on 63.00 kroons.
Union Bank was one of the to ease, ending 0.05 kroons lower at 46.40 kroons on trade of 6.4 million kroons.
The over-the-counter market turned over 6.7 million kroons of shares with Norma plastics maker the most active.
Norma was 0.50 kroons higher on 61.00 kroons after a trade of 2.3 million kroons of shares.
Rakvere meat plant eased 0.10 kroons to close on 14.25 with 2.0 million kroons of shares traded.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn Newsroom, +372 630 8400 or REUTERS@REUTERS.EE
